_note: Each item is a slot for a future affiliate URL. Today `url` is a non-affiliate placeholder: the vendor's public homepage, or https://example.com/affiliate/<slot> when there is no single product page. To go live, replace `url` only. Do not add scripts, pixels, or tracking parameters. The tools page always shows an Affiliate label and rel="sponsored nofollow noopener".
